faults.reviewerReason: FAULT IN THE QUESTION, not only the script. Nothing in the passage evidences the key 'being worried and in a hurry': lines 48-49 give only 'the agitation and half darkness', the preamble says they arrived late 'tired and hungry', and lines 53-54 only that supper was missed. No line shows worry or hurry. The draft fills the gap by invention: 'On a first night in a strange house, the family was worried and rushed about.' is claimed of the passage and is not in it. The key needs rewording to something the text supports (e.g. the upset and bustle of arriving late at night) before any script can be approved.
